exposure: Occiput posterior (OP) fetal position during labor
OP position during the second stage of labor
OP position during the first stage of labor
outcome: Duration of the second stage of labor
finding: OP fetal position during labor was associated with a higher rate of cesarean sections, longer second stage of labor, and more frequent neonatal complications.
mod_finding: The study found that fetuses in the occiput posterior (OP) position during labor had a significantly higher rate of cesarean section compared to those in a non-OP position.
